decisions.briefing: Markets were flat-to-slightly negative today (NASDAQ -0.2%, S&P 500 -0.4%), which doesn't meet the risk-on bar needed to deploy new capital. With only $289.29 cash on hand — below our $500 deployment threshold — and no strong multi-signal setups worth stretching for, we're holding all 7 existing positions and waiting for a clearer risk-on day to fill the remaining 3 slots.

market_education.summary_en: Both major indices drifted lower today in a quiet, directionless session, with the S&P 500 (-0.4%) underperforming the tech-heavy NASDAQ (-0.2%). There was no single dominant catalyst — this looks like routine consolidation after recent gains rather than a shift in sentiment. Without a clear risk-on or risk-off trigger, the safest move is to sit tight rather than chase mixed signals.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日兩大指數皆小幅走弱,標普500指數下跌0.4%,跌幅大於科技股權重較高的納斯達克指數(-0.2%)。市場並未出現明顯的單一觸發因素,較像是近期漲勢後的例行整理,而非市場情緒的轉向。在缺乏明確風險偏好訊號的情況下,按兵不動會比追逐紊亂的訊號更為穩健。

daily_lesson.explanation_en: 'Risk-off' describes a stance where investors pull back from adding new positions because market signals aren't clearly positive. Today's mixed, slightly negative tape combined with cash sitting below our deployment threshold made this a day to hold rather than buy — staying disciplined preserves capital for a higher-conviction setup later.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 「風險規避」(Risk-Off)是指在市場訊號不夠明確正面時,投資人選擇不增加新部位的態度。今日走勢紊亂且略為下跌,加上可用現金低於我們的部署門檻,因此選擇持有觀望而非進場——保持紀律有助於保留資金,等待更具說服力的進場時機。
